rationale: The last five 1-minute candles show a clear and accelerating downward move (25.02 → 24.75) with the final candle printing 186k shares — roughly 4-6x the prior bars — suggesting a momentum flush rather than a clean setup. Price is below both VWAP ($25.15) and the 9-EMA ($25.04), confirming near-term bearish pressure, but the stock has already gapped down ~20% on an earnings miss and is sitting at 43% of today's range with no clear support or exhaustion signal to anchor a short entry, and the risk of a mean-reversion snap-back makes a short equally unattractive. With the daily loss budget nearly consumed ($927 remaining vs. $987 limit) and an existing open position, the asymmetric risk of adding exposure here outweighs any directional edge.
